description: Direct WebFetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/registration/bank-managers returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: Could not read the bank-managers registry page contents (fields, file formats, update cadence). The page appears in search results and a mirror host (roundtable.bank.gov.ua) exposes the same path, so the source is treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.

why_it_matters: This is the highest-value primary source in the cell; the collector must be built with a browser-grade client or the data.gov.ua mirror rather than a naive HTTP fetcher.

description: No dedicated NBU page or dataset found that lists fit-and-proper / погодження decisions on individual bank executives as a structured, dated decision log.

result.result_summary: Approvals surface either as narrative press releases, as Committee on Supervision decision announcements, or as changes in the bank-managers listing — no single decision register was located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Event extraction will need to fuse press releases + registry diffs + NSSMC особлива інформація rather than rely on one feed; a single-source design would under-count events.

description: No NBU careers/vacancies page was located in this pass for the regulator's own hiring (jobs topic).

result.result_summary: Open-data search returned only statistical and normative datasets; the NBU careers surface was not confirmed.

why_it_matters: The 'jobs/hiring' topic for the regulator itself is currently uncovered in this cell; regulator hiring patterns (e.g. new supervision/payments departments) are a leading indicator of organizational change.

description: No official NBU register of key-function holders (ключові особи) of payment institutions was found as a separately published list.

result.result_summary: Business-reputation and professional-suitability requirements for managers/key persons of payment providers are established in NBU Resolution No. 217 and the licensing Regulation, but the resulting person-level data does not appear to be published as an open register.

why_it_matters: Payments-side leadership tracking may have to be reconstructed from the EDR (Opendatabot/YouControl) joined to the NBU entity register, which is slower and less authoritative.

description: No single consolidated public register of current supervisory-board and management-board members across all five state banks was found. The composition has to be reconstructed by joining MoF/Cabinet acts, NBU approvals, issuer disclosures and each bank's own corporate-governance page.

result.result_summary: Composition data exists but is fragmented across at least four publishers; NBU's /bank_managers/ path is the most promising single candidate but its structure was not inspected.

why_it_matters: Any appointments tracker for this cell needs an entity-resolution and reconciliation layer, not a single feed; budget for that in the collector design.

description: Sense Bank is governed differently from the other four (nationalised via the Deposit Guarantee Fund, with boards appointed on MoF proposals and NBU approval), and no MoF/Cabinet competitive-selection announcement pattern for Sense Bank was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Sense Bank leadership change surfaced only through media (kurs.com.ua, RBC, UNIAN, Glavcom) and through Cabinet decisions reported second-hand, not through a discoverable primary vacancy-notice channel.

why_it_matters: For Sense Bank the collection design will lean on media tripwires plus the Cabinet act feed; expect lower precision and slower confirmation than for Oschadbank/Ukreximbank.

description: No 'Clarity Project' equivalent for officer-change monitoring was confirmed. The search for it returned only Opendatabot and YouControl; the tool exists mainly for procurement rather than personnel, so it was not recorded as a candidate.

result.result_summary: Search explicitly returned that results contained no information about a Clarity Project in this context.

why_it_matters: Avoids a fabricated entry; procurement-side registries should be scouted separately if org-change signals from spending are wanted.

description: No dedicated recruitment/careers channel of the state banks (bank career portals, or job boards such as work.ua / robota.ua) was scouted in this pass for senior-hiring or org-restructuring signals.

result.result_summary: Scope was consumed by governance-appointment channels; no career-portal candidate was verified, so none is listed rather than guessed.

why_it_matters: The 'jobs/hiring' topic of the run is currently covered only at board level; mid-level hiring surges are a leading indicator of org change and remain unobserved for this cell.

description: The Oschadbank news/press listing URL was inferred from the bank's domain rather than confirmed from a listing page in the result set, and NBU's /bank_managers/ page structure was not inspected.

result.result_summary: Both are recorded with reduced confidence scores and empty example_urls where no concrete item URL was actually observed.

why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic liveness pass must resolve these two paths before they enter a scheduled crawl.

description: No SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication) Ukraine country-manager or national-member-group leadership announcement channel was located in either language.

result.result_summary: Searches for a SWIFT Ukraine representative/country manager returned only unrelated Western Union and UN-representative results. SWIFT appears to cover Ukraine from a regional office without publicly named country leadership.

why_it_matters: SWIFT country/user-group leadership is a named actor in this cell but may simply not exist as a public role; collection design should not assume a SWIFT Ukraine appointment feed. The Ukrainian SWIFT National Member/User Group, if it exists, would more likely surface via NBU or the Ukrainian Interbank Association rather than swift.com.

description: No Western Union press-release channel announcing Ukraine or CEE country-manager appointments was found.

result.result_summary: Only consumer-facing pages (send/receive money, find locations, become an agent) and the global careers portal surfaced. No people/appointment newsroom for the region.

why_it_matters: Western Union leadership signals in Ukraine will have to be inferred from the ATS, LinkedIn-style profiles, or partner-bank announcements rather than from a primary corporate feed — a structurally weaker evidence base that should be flagged in downstream confidence scoring.

description: No Ukrainian-language corporate channel found for the DFIs (EBRD, IFC, World Bank Group) announcing country-head appointments.

result.result_summary: All located EBRD/IFC/WBG appointment announcements for Ukraine were English-only. Ukrainian-language renderings appear only as secondary reporting by Ukrainian media.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: a uk-only monitoring stack would miss DFI country-leadership changes entirely. English-language DFI newsrooms must be first-class collectors, with uk media used only as confirmation.

description: Search-engine summaries for OTP Bank Ukraine and NBU manager approvals mixed 2020-era and current facts without clear dating.

result.result_summary: Snippets simultaneously asserted a long-serving board chair and a subsequent dismissal of a different chair, with no reliable date ordering.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move collection for this cell must anchor on dated primary artefacts (NBU register entries, the OTP org-structure PDF's 'as at' date, corporate release dates) rather than on aggregated search summaries, which conflate appointment generations.

description: No single stable, canonical index page for Visa CEMEA press releases was identified; releases are mirrored across many country-locale paths.

result.result_summary: The CEMEA release for the regional-president appointment was found only on an African country locale (en_MW), indicating locale mirroring rather than one regional newsroom.

why_it_matters: A collector pointed at a single Visa locale risks missing releases or double-counting mirrors; the collection design needs a locale-normalisation/dedup step keyed on the prl-DDMMYYYY slug.

description: Searched for a dedicated procurement ('закупівлі') section on bank.gov.ua for the National Bank of Ukraine.

result.result_summary: No dedicated NBU procurement landing page surfaced in results; NBU procurement appears via its newsroom announcements and on Prozorro under EDRPOU 00032106. A dedicated page may still exist but was not located.

why_it_matters: Collection for NBU should be anchored on Prozorro by EDRPOU plus the NBU news feed, not on an assumed tender page.

description: Ukrainian-language search for consulting/reorganisation/transformation tenders specifically by Oschadbank and Ukreximbank.

result.result_summary: Only generic Prozorro landing pages and aggregator company pages returned; no specific reorganisation-consulting tender was identified from search-engine results.

why_it_matters: Such tenders are unlikely to be findable via general web search; they require faceted search inside Prozorro (buyer EDRPOU + CPV 79000000 consulting/HR) or the API. Absence here is a search-channel limitation, not evidence the tenders do not exist.

description: Donor/IFI procurement channels (TED, ECEPP, UNDP, UNGM, World Bank) were only found and searched in English.

result.result_summary: No Ukrainian-language mirror or interface for these donor procurement channels was identified during this run.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language coverage of donor procurement may exist via local reposting (e.g. business associations, EU delegation UA pages) and remains an untested collection route.

description: BI Prozorro (Qlik Sense) and EBRD ECEPP (Delta) were not fetched; assessment of automation-friendliness is inference from platform type only.

result.result_summary: Both are recorded as accessible-to-analysts but of unknown automation status; not verified as blocked.

why_it_matters: Collection design should not assume scrapability of either; treat the Prozorro API as the automation path and these as analyst-facing.

description: No public Temenos or Oracle FLEXCUBE implementation announcement naming a Ukrainian bank or a Ukraine-based implementation partner surfaced in this pass.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only generic vendor comparison and aggregator pages; no Ukraine-specific customer story, partner listing or go-live release was found.

why_it_matters: Suggests the Tier-1 Western core-banking vendors have little publicly announced Ukrainian install base, so the indirect route for private banks must lean on domestic vendors (CS Ltd, UNITY-BARS, ProFIX) and processors (UPC, ProCard, TAS-Link) rather than the global names in the cell brief.

description: No dedicated OpenWay case study for a Ukrainian bank was located; the only Ukraine link found was a statement that Way4 project teams span 15+ countries including Ukraine.

result.result_summary: OpenWay customer stories found covered B1NK, Capital Bank and RPC, none Ukrainian.

why_it_matters: OpenWay's Ukraine relevance may be as an employer/delivery location rather than as a supplier to Ukrainian banks — which changes what to monitor (careers and delivery-centre news, not customer stories).

description: The clearest BPC/Ukraine client evidence found (Visa payWave go-live at Credit Dnepr Bank on SmartVista) is an old release republished by trade press, not current BPC newsroom content.

result.result_summary: BPC's own newsroom path was not confirmed in this pass; the Ukraine client evidence came via ATM Marketplace.

why_it_matters: Current BPC activity in Ukraine is unconfirmed; the source is worth tracking but the install-base inference from that release must not be treated as current-state.

description: No established Ukrainian-language term set was found for 'partner-hire announcement' / 'client-side project sponsor' as a discoverable phrase.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian queries surfaced project/implementation vocabulary (впровадження, інтегратор, процесинг) but no idiomatic phrasing that reliably retrieves vendor announcements of client-side leadership.

why_it_matters: Future local-language queries should target concrete artefacts (назва банку + впровадження, кейс, реліз, пресцентр) rather than the abstract concept, or recall will stay low.

description: No specific delivery-centre expansion or banking-vertical hiring announcement was found for SoftServe, Ciklum or Infopulse in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only rankings, generic company profiles and live vacancy feeds were retrieved.

why_it_matters: The expansion signal for this cell will have to be derived from vacancy-count time series and association headcount rankings rather than from press releases.

description: No dedicated, openly discoverable Facebook group specifically named for Ukrainian bankers (e.g. «Банкіри України») could be confirmed via web search; searches returned association pages and generic business groups instead.

result.result_summary: Query 'Facebook група "банкіри України" фінансисти спільнота' returned NABU, AUB, FinClub, Finance.ua pages and a generic 'Бізнес спільнота України' group; one group URL (facebook.com/groups/1650144778533857/) appeared with no readable title behind the login wall.

why_it_matters: Practitioner-only groups are exactly where departures are discussed candidly; if they exist they are closed/private and invisible to search, so the cell may systematically under-cover the most candid layer.

description: LinkedIn people-search and full post feeds — the core asset of this cell — are behind authentication and anti-automation controls.

result.result_summary: Only fragments of profiles and individual post permalinks surface in search-engine results; systematic monitoring requires a logged-in analyst or a licensed LinkedIn product.

why_it_matters: Any collection design that assumes crawlability of LinkedIn will fail or breach ToS; budget must assume manual analyst time or paid tooling.

description: No Ukraine-specific banking HR/recruiter Telegram channel (e.g. a dedicated 'вакансії в банках' channel) was confirmed within this cell's searches.

result.result_summary: Telegram directory articles surfaced general finance/economy channels (Про Бізнес, Ненудні фінанси, Wallet Pro, @uafic, @nbu_ua) but no banking-recruitment-specific channel.

why_it_matters: Hiring-volume weak signals may be better captured by job boards (a different cell); this cell should not claim coverage of vacancy flow.

description: Anonymous Telegram insider channels (e.g. Bankova Mail) mix genuine pre-announcement leaks with political spin and possible disinformation.

result.result_summary: Channel surfaced repeatedly for personnel-related banking/political queries but carries no attributable editorial responsibility.

why_it_matters: Without a mandatory corroboration rule, this cell would inject unverifiable claims about named individuals into the intelligence product.

description: X/Twitter appears to be a marginal channel for Ukrainian banking personnel signals; no substantive X results surfaced across any query in this cell.

result.result_summary: Neither uk nor en queries returned X posts about Ukrainian bank appointments; the seed expectation of X as a weak-signal layer is not supported by evidence gathered here.

why_it_matters: Effort should be reallocated from X to Telegram/Facebook/LinkedIn rather than spread evenly across the four platforms named in the cell brief.

description: Direct fetch of https://www.finawards.com.ua/2026 returned HTTP 404, although /2025, /2023 and /2021 year paths appear in search results and 2026 award coverage is abundant in the press.

result.result_summary: Most likely the current edition lives at the site root or a renamed path rather than the year path; recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The FinAwards jury page is the single richest bulk title source in this cell (17 bank board chairs plus 40+ experts); a wrong URL pattern would silently drop it from collection.

description: The EMA conferences index page lists 26 editions of Payments & Security plus adjacent events but exposes only titles and dates — no speaker names at the index level.

result.result_summary: Speaker rosters, if present, sit on the individual per-conference pages, which were not fetched in this pass.

why_it_matters: Collection design must budget for a per-event crawl rather than a single index parse; the assumption that EMA publishes speaker bios is a hypothesis pending verification of one event page.

description: For several 2026 events (FinRetail 2026 on 16 Sept, Pay.Forum 2026, Fintech & Payments Forum 2026) media coverage explicitly states the programme and speaker list were still being confirmed at the time of search.

result.result_summary: Speaker data for the current cycle is time-gated rather than absent.

why_it_matters: A one-shot crawl before the event yields near-empty rosters; collection must poll and capture the final agenda, and ideally a post-event snapshot.

description: Searching KSE for a banking-specific executive programme returned only general MBA / Management Mastery / corporate-programme descriptions and finance master's degrees; no banking-executive programme was identified.

result.result_summary: KSE is confirmed as an executive-education actor but not as a banking-specific cohort source.

why_it_matters: Downgrades KSE's usefulness for cohort-based executive detection relative to kmbs, which does run a Master in Banking and Finance.

description: No single canonical Ukrainian-language term for an award literally called 'банкір року' as a standalone prize was found; the local naming is 'номінація Банкір року' inside FinAwards, alongside separate franchises 'Банк року' (Мінфін / Фінансовий клуб / МФК БАНКИРЪ) and 'Банки року' (finclub).

result.result_summary: Glossary must treat 'банкір року' as a nomination label, not an award name, and carry all three competing 'банк(и) року' franchises as distinct actors.

why_it_matters: Searching only for 'банкір року' misses two of the three award ecosystems and would undercount jury rosters by a large margin.

description: Two acronym collisions must be handled: 'EMA' is both the Ukrainian ЄМА interbank association and the London-based Electronic Money Association (and the European Medicines Agency); 'НАБУ/NABU' is both the banking association (nabu.ua, styled Незалежна and later Національна Асоціація Банків України) and the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine.

result.result_summary: Both collisions produced off-target results during searching and were disambiguated by domain.

why_it_matters: Automated query expansion on these acronyms will pull in large volumes of irrelevant anti-corruption and EU-pharma content; pin collection to the domains ema.com.ua and nabu.ua.

description: No evidence was found in this pass that a 2026 edition of the ICU Ukrainian Financial Forum (uff.icu) took place; searches surfaced only the forum's about/history pages describing editions from 2014 onward.

result.result_summary: The site is live but the event may be dormant or unannounced.

why_it_matters: A source that stopped producing new rosters has archival value only; priority should be revisited once liveness is checked.

description: No established Ukrainian-language term was identified for 'jury roster' as a structured, machine-readable artefact; sites use prose formulations ('до складу журі увійшли', 'експертне журі') rather than a labelled page type.

result.result_summary: Local-language term coverage for the structural concept is weak, though the topical vocabulary (журі, номінація, спікери, програма, агенда) is solid.

why_it_matters: Extraction must rely on prose NER over Ukrainian text rather than on locating a standard page template.

description: No Ukraine-specific banking/financial-services salary guide from a global recruiter (Hays, Michael Page, Robert Walters, Korn Ferry) was located. Hays publishes salary guides for the US/Canada/UK and Michael Page for banking & financial services in other markets, but searches surfaced no Ukraine edition.

result.result_summary: Global recruiter salary guides exist but appear not to cover Ukraine; UA comp benchmarking seems to be served by local agencies, EBA member surveys and derived media analyses instead.

why_it_matters: Means there is no off-the-shelf international benchmark for UA banking pay; comp intelligence must be assembled from Держстат KVED-K wages, NBU personnel-expense data and EBA/local agency surveys.

description: The Independent Association of Banks of Ukraine (НАБУ) was checked for an HR/personnel committee. Its published committee list covers taxation & accounting, regulatory policy & compliance, and legal/creditor-rights matters only.

result.result_summary: No HR or workforce committee found at the main banking association.

why_it_matters: There is no sector-level bank HR body producing aggregate workforce statistics, so bank staffing intelligence has to come from the regulator, statistics office and commercial recruiters rather than an industry HR forum.

description: ANCOR, named in the cell brief as a recruiter, has its principal web presence and salary-survey product on ancor.ru, a Russia-domiciled group site; only a Ukrainian agency profile page was found via work.ua.

result.result_summary: ANCOR's Ukraine-specific salary-survey output could not be confirmed as independently published from a Ukrainian entity.

why_it_matters: Procuring or citing RU-linked workforce research for a Ukraine banking study carries sanctions, data-integrity and reputational risk; it should be screened or substituted.

description: No public dataset was found that reports headcount per individual Ukrainian bank on a recurring basis. Media report system-level and occasionally single-bank figures (e.g. PrivatBank ~19.8k) sourced from NBU/statement disclosures, but not a maintained per-bank series.

result.result_summary: Per-bank headcount must be reconstructed from bank annual reports/financial statements rather than a ready-made regulator series.

why_it_matters: Any per-institution workforce tracking will require statement-level extraction, which is slower and less frequent than branch-count tracking.

description: Searches in Ukrainian on branch closures plus mobilisation returned abundant material on branch-network contraction but essentially nothing quantifying how many bank employees have been mobilised, deferred (заброньовані) or relocated.

result.result_summary: Mobilisation impact on bank staffing is described qualitatively and regulated procedurally, but not measured publicly.

why_it_matters: The most distinctive UA workforce driver is the least quantified; estimates will need proxies (deferment-quota rules, vacancy mix, personnel expense) or primary interviews.

description: The intuitive press-centre paths https://raiffeisen.ua/about/press-center and https://about.pumb.ua/press-center both returned HTTP 404. The real paths are /about/press and /presscenter respectively.

result.result_summary: Two 404s; correct paths subsequently found via domain-scoped local-language search. Recorded as a path-discovery lesson, NOT as dead sources.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian bank sites do not follow the English 'press-center' convention consistently; a collector built on guessed paths will silently collect nothing. Always resolve newsroom paths from sitemap.xml or search before configuring a crawler.

description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the PUMB press centre or the OTP Bank news index during inspection of those pages.

result.result_summary: PUMB offers month/year archive filters and OTP offers numeric pagination plus an email subscription, but neither surfaced a machine-readable feed.

why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be HTML-crawl based rather than feed based, which raises cost and fragility. Both sites do use enumerable IDs (PUMB /item/{id}-, OTP /about/news/{id}/), so ID-walking is a viable substitute for a feed and gives free gap detection.

description: No dedicated press centre or news path was located for àбанк / А-Банк on a-bank.com.ua despite Ukrainian-language searching with all three of its naming variants (А-Банк, Абанк, àбанк).

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced only third-party feeds (minfin, finance.ua, nv.ua, mind.ua, banker.ua) carrying A-Bank news. The bank's own newsroom either does not exist, is not indexed, or sits on an unguessed path.

why_it_matters: One of the seven named cell actors has no confirmed first-party record. Leadership and organisational news for A-Bank must be sourced through aggregators, which weakens provenance and delays detection. Needs a manual sitemap.xml reconnaissance pass.

description: The Sense Bank corporate domain (sensebank.com.ua) and the Ukrainian-language paths for Credit Agricole (/o-banke/pres-centr/novini, /o-banke/pravlinnya, derived by removing the /en/ prefix from confirmed English URLs) were inferred, not fetched.

result.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence scores and flagged for the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Sense Bank is currently the highest-volatility actor in the cell (Aug 2026 suspensions of both board and supervisory board heads). Building on an unverified domain would silently drop the most active source. Verify before wiring into collection.

description: A legacy Raiffeisen path (https://raiffeisen.ua/ru/press/news/?id=62205) surfaced in search results with the title 'Just a moment...', indicating a Cloudflare-style JS challenge.

result.result_summary: Hypothesis only: bot-defended-but-live. The current-generation paths (/news, /en/news) did not show the same signature in search results.

why_it_matters: The collector for raiffeisen.ua should use a browser-capable fetcher with a realistic user agent rather than a bare HTTP client, and should not mark the domain dead on a challenge response.

description: Ukrainian spelling variants materially change search recall: 'Райффайзен' (double ф) vs 'Райфайзен' (single ф) return different Work.ua result sets, and the bank legally dropped 'Аваль' from its name on 17 June, so 'Райффайзен Банк Аваль' now retrieves mostly pre-rename material. Similarly A-Bank has three live renderings (А-Банк / Абанк / àбанк, rebranded 16 Sep 2024) and Sense Bank's pre-2022 identity is Альфа-Банк Україна.

result.result_summary: Documented as a glossary/alias requirement rather than a source.

why_it_matters: Any monitoring query set that fixes on one spelling will miss a large fraction of coverage, and time-series continuity across the rename events will break unless aliases are mapped to a single canonical entity.

description: The Ukrainian phrase 'призначення голови правління' is heavily dominated by state-sector results — Cabinet of Ministers decrees, state enterprises and NBU internal appointments crowd out commercial bank hits unless the query is bank-name-scoped or domain-scoped.

result.result_summary: Observed on the first seed query, where the top result was a Cabinet of Ministers appointment decree for an unrelated state leasing company.

why_it_matters: Generic appointment-term monitoring will produce a low signal-to-noise ratio for this cell. Queries must be anchored on the bank name or restricted to the bank's own domain / a specialist aggregator such as finclub.net.

description: No dedicated UA-language people-moves / appointments tracker specific to the payments industry was found. Ukrainian coverage of payment-institution executive hires is scattered across general business media (Liga, Interfax, ThePage), trade media (psm7, Finclub, Banker) and company sites; there is no equivalent of an HR-newswire for the sector.

result.result_summary: Searches on кадрові призначення + платіжний ринок returned trade-media home pages and awards items, not an appointments desk or column.

why_it_matters: Recall for this cell must be built by fan-out across many feeds plus registry change-monitoring, rather than by subscribing to one authoritative people feed; budget for that.

description: Targeted searches for management/leadership changes at Portmone, LeoGaming and City24 returned only product, partnership and enforcement news — no appointment coverage surfaced for these specific named actors.

result.result_summary: Portmone results were product pages (billing.portmone.com.ua); LeoGaming results were gaming-payment partnership items; City24 results were NBU fine coverage.

why_it_matters: Mid-size UA PSPs and terminal networks do not publicise executive hires. Their management changes are likely only observable via ЄДР director-change monitoring (YouControl/Opendatabot), which raises the priority of the paid registry layer for this cell.

description: No settled local-language term was found for 'Concord-successors'. Searching Конкорд наступники returned only liquidation coverage (the bank ceased to exist as a legal entity in May 2026) and passing references to Concord Fintech Solutions.

result.result_summary: Concord's liquidation is well covered; the successor-entity/talent-diaspora angle has no local term or dedicated coverage.

why_it_matters: The 'where did the Concord payments team go' question cannot be answered by keyword search; it needs person-level tracking (LinkedIn, event speaker lists, ЄДР founder/director records) rather than a term-based feed.

description: The NBU payment-infrastructure register was located as a page but its machine-readable register file/URL pattern was not established in this pass, and no direct fetch of the register content was performed.

result.result_summary: Register landing page identified at bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps; downloadable dataset location unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: The register is the join key for the whole cell; if it is HTML-only or PDF-only, collection cost and diffing design change materially.

description: LinkedIn was not searched or assessed in this pass, despite being the single richest source of individual-level moves for UA fintech executives.

result.result_summary: No LinkedIn candidate recorded; access and ToS constraints unassessed.

why_it_matters: A large recall gap for A5 leadership moves; needs a deliberate legal/access decision before the next pass.

description: sportbank, named in the cell definition, appears to have been shut down on 17 April 2024; Tascombank now lists izibank as its only mobile-banking partner.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only historical sportbank items (incl. a 2023 finclub piece on a change of its head). No current sportbank hiring or leadership source found.

why_it_matters: The cell's actor list is stale; sportbank should be treated as an archive-only actor and collection effort reallocated to live challengers.

description: No dedicated press/careers/leadership channel was found for izibank as a distinct brand — it is governed through Tascombank.

result.result_summary: izibank.com.ua surfaced only FAQ/product pages; management information sits on tascombank.ua.

why_it_matters: Leadership signals for izibank must be tracked at the licensing-bank level, not the brand level; a brand-level watch would return nothing.

description: The NBU dataset that publishes bank managers (запроваджено after NBU began publishing manager information) could not be pinned to a current bank.gov.ua URL in this pass; only an old.bank.gov.ua article and secondary reporting were found.

result.result_summary: Search returned zib.com.ua/NV coverage and legal commentary rather than the live dataset page.

why_it_matters: This is the authoritative regulator source for board-level moves at every licensed neobank partner; leaving it unpinned is the single biggest gap in the cell.

description: English-language search for 2026 monobank product-lead hires returned only company profiles and funding coverage, no people-level news.

result.result_summary: CBInsights/Tracxn/Vestbee/Wikipedia hits only.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: people-level neobank signals in UA are local-language and social-channel-borne; an English-only pipeline would miss essentially all of them.

description: No stable Ukrainian term was identified for 'card-issuing challenger'; local usage collapses to 'необанк' or 'мобільний банк-партнер'.

result.result_summary: Searches on issuing-specific phrasing returned generic необанк overviews.

why_it_matters: Query design must rely on brand names plus 'необанк'/'банк-партнер' rather than a functional issuing term, or recall will be poor.

description: Direct Ukrainian- and English-language queries aimed at LinkedIn job pages for Ukraine banking leadership roles returned zero linkedin.com results; the engine returned Glassdoor mirrors instead.

result.result_summary: No LinkedIn job URLs surfaced via web search. This is consistent with LinkedIn job search being login-gated and largely de-indexed, not with the pages being absent. Recorded as unverified/hypothesis, not dead.

why_it_matters: LinkedIn is the primary channel for senior banking/payments roles and the only practical source for individual leadership moves in UA. If it cannot be reached by search or crawl, the 'leadership moves' topic in this cell must rely on manual analyst review or a licensed product, which changes cost and cadence assumptions.

description: No documented public/free vacancy API was found for work.ua, robota.ua, Djinni, DOU or Jooble during this pass. Jooble's site references partner/employer integrations and the state portal references API-based syndication, but no open developer documentation was located.

result.result_summary: Only the state open-data route (data.gov.ua CKAN, form 3-ПН) is confirmed as a licence-clean machine-readable channel.

why_it_matters: Collection for the commercial boards will have to be HTML/DOM-based and therefore ToS-exposed and fragile. A licensing conversation (about.robota.ua, ua.jooble.org/info/contacts) may be a cheaper long-term path than scraping.

description: Searched for published time-series of banking/finance vacancy volume in Ukraine; found platform-level labour-market studies (robota.ua/budni, Work.ua articles, Djinni monthly analytics) but no banking-sector-specific vacancy index.

result.result_summary: Sector-specific vacancy-volume history does not appear to exist as a published product; it must be constructed from our own daily/weekly snapshots.

why_it_matters: Means the leading-indicator value of this cell only accrues after we start snapshotting — there is no backfill. Collection should start immediately even before analysis is designed.

description: Several local terms are noisy: 'банк' collides with 'банк даних'/'банк вакансій'; 'процесинг' appears in non-payment manufacturing contexts; 'еквайринг' is clean but low-volume; 'Jooble'/'Djinni' as query terms return the platforms' own hiring rather than banking vacancies (observed directly — the jooble query returned jobs AT Jooble).

result.result_summary: Naive keyword filters will produce substantial false positives and, for platform names, entirely off-target results.

why_it_matters: Any vacancy-volume series must apply company-level and category-level filters, not keyword-only matching, or trend lines will be dominated by noise.

description: No dedicated 'кадри' / 'призначення' rubric exists on finclub.net. A direct fetch of the site returned its full rubric list (Новини, Статті, Пряма мова, Розслідування, Інфографіка, Досьє, Відео/Фото, Огляди, Банки-банкроти, Спецпроєкти) with no personnel section; appointment items sit inside the general news feed.

result.result_summary: Personnel news must be extracted by keyword filtering of the general news stream, not by subscribing to a rubric feed.

why_it_matters: The cell hypothesis that several outlets run dedicated appointments rubrics does not hold for the most personnel-dense outlet found; collection design must assume keyword filtering as the default mechanism.

description: No standalone 'призначення' or 'кадрові зміни' tag/rubric page could be confirmed for Forbes Ukraine, NV Business, or Ekonomichna Pravda. Searches scoped to those outlets returned individual appointment articles but no rubric landing page.

result.result_summary: Appointment coverage on the major Ukrainian business outlets appears to be tagged per-company/per-person rather than aggregated under a personnel rubric.

why_it_matters: Per-company tag archives (Forbes /profile/<company>, NV /ukr/tags/<slug>, Ukrinform /tag-<slug>) are the practical aggregation unit — collection should be actor-indexed rather than rubric-indexed.

description: Searches for an appointments/HR rubric on Mind.ua returned nothing about that outlet at all; results drifted to universities and unrelated content. Mind.ua could not be confirmed as an active appointments-coverage source in this pass.

result.result_summary: Mind.ua remains an unverified hypothesis for this cell.

why_it_matters: Mind.ua is a well-known Ukrainian business outlet; its absence from results is more likely a search-surface artefact than evidence it stopped covering the sector. It should be probed directly rather than dropped.

description: AIN.ua and MC.today produced no hits for banking/fintech executive appointments in this pass, despite being the standard Ukrainian tech-business outlets. No article URLs were obtained, so neither is recorded as a candidate.

result.result_summary: Tech-media coverage of fintech leadership moves is unconfirmed for this cell.

why_it_matters: Payments/fintech leadership moves (the non-bank half of sector=both) may be under-covered by classic business media and are more likely to surface on tech outlets; leaving this unresolved risks a systematic blind spot on the fintech side.

description: No Ukrainian-language equivalent term was found for a media 'appointments column' as a named rubric. The working local terms used were кадрові зміни, призначення, очолив/очолить, звільнився, звільнити, припинив повноваження, відсторонив, наглядова рада, голова правління — these behave as article-body keywords, not as rubric labels.

result.result_summary: The glossary is verb-driven rather than rubric-driven.

why_it_matters: Any future crawler must be built around a Ukrainian verb/role lexicon; a rubric-subscription design would silently under-collect.

description: The term 'кадрові зміни' alone is dominated by government/ministerial reshuffles rather than banking; 'звільнення' collides with dismissal-of-employees and with military/mobilization contexts; 'НБУ' returns heavy regulatory-policy noise unrelated to personnel.

result.result_summary: Bare local keywords need institution-name co-occurrence to be usable.

why_it_matters: Precision of any alerting rule depends on pairing verbs with an actor list (bank names, НБУ, ФГВФО, specific payment companies); otherwise volume will be unmanageable.

description: Interfax-Ukraine's full agency product is subscription-based; only the free public web items were observed. Whether the public feed is a complete or partial mirror of the wire could not be established without a subscription.

result.result_summary: Coverage completeness of the free Interfax feed is unknown.

why_it_matters: If the free feed is a curated subset, appointment items may be silently missing from an otherwise high-credibility source; a paid feed decision may be warranted for the highest-value wire in this cell.

description: Searched for a dedicated personnel/appointments rubric on PaySpace Magazine (psm7.com) using the uk query 'psm7.com рубрика новини банків "призначен" фінтех кадри'. The engine returned only unrelated habr.com results; a direct fetch of psm7.com/uk/ shows rubrics organised by topic (bank, fintech, payment-systems, blockchain, interview) with no people/appointments tag.

result.result_summary: No 'кадри'/'призначення' tag exists on psm7.com; personnel items are scattered across topical rubrics.

why_it_matters: Collection from PaySpace must be keyword-filtered across several rubrics rather than pointed at one tag URL, raising noise and cost for a key payments-side source.

description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was exposed on the psm7.com Ukrainian homepage; only a Google News publication badge was present. Minfin, Mind.ua, Banker.ua and Censor.net feed URLs were likewise not confirmed within this run.

result.result_summary: FinClub is the only cell source with a confirmed advertised feed (https://finclub.net/all.html?format=feed).

why_it_matters: Most of the cell will need HTML listing crawlers rather than feed polling, which is more brittle and more likely to trip bot defences.

description: The cell brief names 'Ekonomika+' as a seed outlet. Searches did not surface a Ukrainian banking/payments trade portal under that name; the plausible neighbours found instead were Економічна правда (epravda.com.ua) and Mind.ua. No URL is asserted for 'Ekonomika+' because none was actually observed.

result.result_summary: 'Ekonomika+' could not be resolved to a real domain in this run.

why_it_matters: Either the brief's name is an alias/misspelling, or a genuine outlet is missing from coverage; leaving it unresolved risks a silent gap.

description: Bankchart.com.ua was probed as a cell seed. Its content is product comparison, bank ratings and market reviews of deposit/credit/card products; no personnel or restructuring reporting was observed.

result.result_summary: Bankchart carries structural/market data but essentially no A5 personnel signal.

why_it_matters: It should be demoted to a low-priority reference baseline rather than crawled daily for A5 topics.

description: English-language searching for Ukrainian payments/banking personnel news surfaced only global trade titles (FinTech Global, FinTech Futures, The Paypers, FF News) and one association/event page; no English-language Ukraine-specific personnel wire was found.

result.result_summary: English coverage of UA second-tier appointments is effectively absent; global fintech titles cover Ukraine only at unicorn/funding level.

why_it_matters: Confirms that uk-language collection is mandatory for A5 in this cell — an English-only pipeline would miss nearly all department-head and regional-director moves.

description: Banker.ua, PaySpace Awards content and association newsrooms mix editorial with sponsored/press-release material; several observed items read as promotional.

result.result_summary: A meaningful share of cell content is PR rather than independent reporting.

why_it_matters: Appointment items sourced only from PR need corroboration (NBU register, FinClub, Forbes) before being treated as confirmed leadership moves.

description: Searched for a dedicated Opendatabot product for monitoring bank executive changes specifically (queries in Ukrainian).

result.result_summary: Found only generic company-level ЄДР change monitoring and a state-companies monitoring service; no banking-specific leadership-change feed was documented.

why_it_matters: The A5 monitor must build the bank/payment-provider filter itself on top of a generic register-change stream; no vendor ships it ready-made.

description: Attempted automated fetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps and https://opendatabot.ua/sources.

result.result_summary: Both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetcher, while both are indexed and described in search results.

why_it_matters: These are bot-defence hypotheses, not dead links. Collection design for both domains must budget for a headless browser or a licensed API rather than naive HTTP.

description: Looked for a standing, published NBU register listing approved bank executives («погоджені керівники банків») as a browsable list.

result.result_summary: Found the legal approval regime and NBU rule changes about it, but no evidence of a public, continuously published register of approved bank managers.

why_it_matters: The regulator's approval step exists but is not a directly harvestable register; ЄДР and SMIDA remain the practical primary sources for named appointments.

description: Searched in English for an official NBU English-language downloadable list of licensed payment service providers.

result.result_summary: English NBU pages on open banking and nonbank licensing exist but no complete English open-data list of authorised PSPs was located; substantive content is Ukrainian-only.

why_it_matters: English-only collection would systematically under-cover the Ukrainian payments entity universe; Ukrainian-language ingestion is mandatory for this cell.

description: Assessed whether SMIDA/stockmarket disclosure covers all banks.

result.result_summary: Особлива інформація obligations bind issuers (joint-stock companies with registered securities); banks and payment firms outside that perimeter, notably LLC-form payment companies, will not appear there.

why_it_matters: SMIDA alone leaves a blind spot over non-issuer fintech/payment institutions; the ЄДР diff is the only source with full entity coverage.

description: The cell brief names 'NABU (Independent Association of Banks of Ukraine)'. Multiple uk sources (Interfax-Ukraine, Ekonomichna Pravda, borgexpert) report that Незалежна асоціація банків України renamed itself to Національна асоціація банків України — nabu.ua now presents the National name while many page titles and inbound links still carry the Independent one.

result.result_summary: Both names are in live use across the same domain; the acronym НАБУ is unchanged.

why_it_matters: Entity resolution will fragment if the collector treats the two names as different organisations. Worse, НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (also НАБУ), the dominant sense in uk search — an uncontrolled keyword feed on 'НАБУ' will be overwhelmingly anti-corruption news noise.

description: WebFetch of https://nabu.ua/ua/struktura-nabu.html returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the first attempt during this pass.

result.result_summary: No content retrieved; page content is nonetheless well indexed by search, indicating the site is live and bot-throttled rather than down.

why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis of throttling, not a dead source. A collector must rate-limit nabu.ua aggressively; a naive crawler will get itself banned from the single most important source in this cell.

description: WebFetch of https://fintechua.org/about returned essentially empty content ('..'), indicating client-side rendering.

result.result_summary: UAFIC board and member data are not in the served HTML.

why_it_matters: The fintech-side association — one of the four named in the cell pointer — cannot be collected with plain HTTP fetching. A headless browser stage is required, or the data must be sourced indirectly (trade media, registry).

description: aub.org.ua serves the same content under both legacy /index.php/pro-asotsiatsiiu/... and clean /working-body/... paths, and a fetch of https://aub.org.ua/pro-asotsiatsiiu/rada-aub returned an archived news article from May 2004 rather than the current council roster.

result.result_summary: Current AUB council composition was not retrieved in this pass; only the presidency was corroborated from search (Andrii Bohdanovych, as of Dec 2025).

why_it_matters: A diff-based collector pointed at the wrong AUB path will silently monitor a 2004 archive page and report 'no change' forever. Path selection must be validated manually before the source is trusted.

description: Targeted uk search for a named Board Chair (Голова Ради) of the EMA association returned the board page URL and the 24 Oct 2025 General Assembly member-institution list, but no chair name in the search excerpt.

result.result_summary: EMA board composition at institution level is evidenced; the individual chair is not, from search alone.

why_it_matters: The payments-side chair is a high-value data point; it requires a direct render of https://www.ema.com.ua/about/board/ rather than search-derived extraction. Note also that EMA's board is composed of institutions (Mastercard, Visa, banks), so person-level extraction needs the delegate names on the page itself.

description: No EBA Ukraine banking/financial-services committee chair election was found; the committee-election pattern was only confirmed on the Ukraine Recovery Committee (chair elected 19 Dec 2025).

result.result_summary: The mechanism is confirmed for EBA generally; the specific financial-sector committee page URL remains unlocated.

why_it_matters: EBA is scored on an inferred pattern rather than a verified banking-committee page — its confidence is correspondingly lower and it needs a directed crawl of the EBA committees index before being promoted.

description: For the Ukrainian Credit-Banking Union (UKBS), indexed material and membership figures trace to 2014 or earlier, and two competing domains appeared (ukbs.org.ua, kbs.org.ua). No current council or president was found in either uk search.

result.result_summary: Organisation exists in the state register (EDRPOU 21573585) but current web activity is unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: Spending collection budget on a dormant association is waste; conversely, recording it as dead on this evidence would be premature. Needs a manual liveness check, not an automated verdict.

description: No established Ukrainian-language term was found for 'self-regulatory organisation' as applied to the banking and payments sector specifically. 'Саморегулівна організація (СРО)' is a securities-market concept under the NSSMC; banking and payments bodies in Ukraine describe themselves as громадська спілка / асоціація / об'єднання, not СРО.

result.result_summary: Searching 'саморегулівна організація' in a banking/payments context yields credit-union and securities-market results, not banking associations.

why_it_matters: The cell's framing as 'self-regulatory bodies' does not translate to a productive uk query term for banking/payments. Query design must instead use асоціація / спілка / об'єднання / рада + голова/правління/комітет.

description: No association was found that publishes a job-vacancies or recruitment feed for the sector; the 'jobs/hiring' topic is only weakly served by this cell.

result.result_summary: Association sources yield appointments and elections, not job postings. The nearest adjacency found was jobs.dou.ua hosting a UAFIC company page.

why_it_matters: Cell #10 should be scoped as a leadership/organisation-change source, with jobs and hiring coverage delegated to job-board and company-careers cells; expecting vacancy data here will produce a false coverage claim.
